entities.name: Mogis
aliases: God of Slaughter, Violence, and War
entities.description: The god of slaughter, violence and war on Theros, a four-horned minotaur who embodies uncontrolled rage and is twin brother of Iroas.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane whose gods include Mogis.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: Mogis's twin brother, god representing honorable victory in battle.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A god with a functional relationship with Mogis who manipulates him to disrupt Heliod.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god whose schemes Erebos uses Mogis to disrupt.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A god Mogis respects for the chaos he causes.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A god Mogis disdains for her orderly cities and rules.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A god Mogis disdains for aiding the weak; she retaliates against his destruction of fields.

entities.name: Minotaurs
entities.description: The most fervent devotees of Mogis.

entities.name: Rhordon
entities.description: Mogis's oracle, secretly aided by him in a duel with Anax.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: Fought a duel with Rhordon shortly before the Great Revel.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: The time when all the gods of Theros were silenced and unable to influence mortal battles.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: An event shortly after the duel between Rhordon and Anax.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis where Mogis's "red eye" is a common profanity.

events.summary: Silenced like all Theros gods, Mogis circumvents the restriction by secretly aiding his oracle Rhordon in a duel with Anax shortly before the Great Revel.
events.quote: he circumvented this restriction by secretly aiding his oracle Rhordon during a duel with Anax

relations.quote: acting as the dark counterpart and twin brother of the god Iroas

relations.note: Mogis desires to destroy Iroas and become the sole god of war.
relations.quote: Mogis desires to destroy Iroas and become the sole god of war.

relations.note: A functional relationship, with Erebos appreciating the souls Mogis sends to the underworld.
relations.quote: He shares a functional relationship with Erebos

relations.note: Mogis harbors deep disdain for her.
relations.quote: he harbors deep disdain for Ephara and Karametra

relations.note: Mogis disdains her and destroys fertile fields to provoke her.
relations.quote: He enjoys destroying fertile fields, provoking harsh retaliations from Karametra.

relations.note: Mogis respects Phenax for the chaos he causes.
relations.quote: Mogis holds respect for Phenax due to the chaos Phenax causes
